cost.integration: left endpoint, interval-average measured planar velocity

geometry.simulation_footprint: disc radius 0.20 m; reduced planar benchmark, not full Go2 envelope
geometry.hardware_footprint: oriented 0.70 m x 0.32 m rectangle including feet envelope
geometry.planning: physical obstacle Minkowski footprint first, then delta
geometry.MC: per-trial minimum signed clearance clipped to zero at contact; all trials

pairing.alignment: linear interpolation on common 0.2s grid; no warping
pairing.duration: prescribed family duration, valid pairs finish full common window; terminated/damaged records excluded before split
pairing.deviation: max Euclidean distance at common timestamps
pairing.cost_zero: base rate positive and duration>0; invalid zero-duration record excluded

budget.online: shadow nominal tracker rollout under identical command sequence, cumulative corrected nominal charge
budget.evaluation: sum executed raw cost > initial budget, continue after crossing

trajectory_case.scope: separate short diagnostic map, same proxy units, not pooled in main-table trials

observations.navigation: 36 horizontal range rays, body-frame goal (2), planar velocity and yaw-rate (3), previous command (3), safety bit (1), budget/z_ref (1)
observations.state: planar pose, velocity, map, goal plus safety history and budget

statistics.aggregation: equal weighting of three scene means; balanced allocation makes pooled proportion equivalent

events.collision: physical contact before terminal; mutually exclusive with success
events.failure: collision or timeout; hardware adds localization abort

intervals.rates: Wilson score n=300, conditional on fixed bank of trained policies and independently sampled maps
intervals.continuous: two-sided Student t n=300 from individually authored mean and trial SD; conditional on same bank
intervals.scope: marginal descriptive intervals; not across-training-seed generalization, not paired difference significance
intervals.legacy: old manual ranges retained unchanged; new intervals recalculated from explicit synthetic counts/SD

selection.role: separate design split; final curve does not establish selection decisions
selection.budget_plot: final response curve; outlined point is smallest passing tested point in that curve, not independently certified optimum

low_level.freeze: all weights and observation normalization before calibration

network.distribution: diagonal Gaussian latent action, learned state-independent log_std
network.command: clip latent to[-1,1], multiply[0.6,0.4,1.2]; likelihood uses preclip latent action

normalization.budget: divide scenario z_ref; no running normalization
normalization.residual: goal signed distance/6m, C=2, cost value and budget divided by z_ref before max

targets.common_stop: argmin over rollout suffix max(reach penalty, normalized corrected accumulated cost-budget); bootstrap end candidate
targets.cost: nonnegative corrected return to same stop, gamma_cost1
targets.reach: lambda mixture of discounted min-reach n-step targets, same stopping mask
targets.actor_loss: minimize E[max(r*A,clip(r,1-eps,1+eps)*A)]-entropy_coef*H; A=lambda combined return - combined old value

terminal.training: physical contact or goal or30s; inflated unsafe entry sets persistent y=+1, does not early reset
terminal.budget: negative z retained; not early reset
terminal.horizon: 30s is task terminal, no bootstrap; artificial rollout cut before terminal bootstraps from next augmented state
terminal.boundary: actual terminal target=max(goal penalty,C*y,-remaining_budget/z_ref); cost terminal continuation0

phase2.search: finite candidate grid, rollout acceptance not critic sign alone

scenarios.generation: reject physical-footprint blocked start/goal and disconnected free-space samples; same maps/starts across methods; no rejection based on delta
scenarios.splits: independent random maps/commands for calibration, training, budget selection and final tests; three trained policies per method

baselines.common: same observations, command limits, tracker, maps, training interaction budget and architecture; RA omits budget input
baselines.RA: minimize reach-only residual; no cost conditioning
baselines.CPPO: same shaped reward and safety beta; Lagrangian clipped-PPO with E[J/z_ref]<=1, dual projected[0,100], lr0.01 initial1; no separate theoretical guarantee

scenarios.reference_budget_rationale: timeouts incur >=108 a.u.; reference budgets must not force all timeouts to violate smaller thresholds. 120/140/190 cover progressively larger cost dispersion; 85 is short diagnostic case only.

calibration.source: 绘图/20261025_裕度校准与独立检验图/data/paired_rollouts.csv
calibration.sampling: piecewise commands held1s, linear0.2s ramps; common paired command; families x5profiles,40cal+20held percell; admissible no-contact control arena

quantile.bootstrap: paired rows resampled within each of20condition strata; fixed-mix percentile95%

calibration.LiDAR: excluded from margin fit; separate sensor check uses Gaussian range SD0.02m, 5%dropout filled atmaxrange; no numerical navigation claim from it
calibration.limitation: delay100ms exceeds40ms training randomization; calibration explicitly includes such mismatch; no claim training covers all calibration profiles

perturbation.training: reuse fixed main policies and alpha/delta; no retraining
perturbation.shift: each profile deviation from nominal multiplied by1.25: mu=.8+1.25*(mu_cal-.8), delay=1.25*delay_cal,noise=1.25*noise_cal
perturbation.evaluation: 300 independent trials per scene; 60 per profile per scene; aggregate900

hardware.robot: Unitree Go2; existing photos are historical qualitative material
hardware.sensors: joint encoders and IMU for proprioception; horizontal projection of onboard LiDAR for36range bins; local scan-matching pose
hardware.compute: onboard x86_64 CPU,16GB RAM; policy inference50Hz low/5Hz high;200Hz joint-position PD interface
hardware.policy: fixed pretrained tracker and high-level mean; reference budget230 chosen in separate setup, no hardware tuning of margins
hardware.source_status: authored_example except existing photos and inherited route description
